beforeDescription: Earth-1610 gives Spider-Man, the X-Men, the Ultimates and the Fantastic Four fresh starts, building toward Ultimate War. Brian Michael Bendis's Ultimate Spider-Man runs alongside Mark Millar's Ultimate X-Men and Ultimates, with Ultimate Marvel Team-Up, Daredevil and Elektra, and Ultimate Iron Man along the way. The selection is not in publication order and omits an entry marked out of continuity.
